summary: Implementation plan for Flower AI, an advanced Jarvis-like multimodal AI assistant featuring a Cyberpunk HUD interface, dynamic personality switching (intimate romantic partner, witty Jarvis, full-stack coder, website builder), native Android device hardware control (flashlight, volume, brightness, app launcher), voice interaction with wake-word detection ('Hey Flower', 'Hello', 'Hubuhu'), image vision analysis, search grounding, and AI image generation.
